Actual downloaded size and SHA256 must match that metadata at341-342 before rawFiles writes. mkdtemp239 plus chmod0700 creates a private directory, the filename is a fixed literal241, and wx/0600 prevents clobbering an existing file. The file is reopened read-only/no-follow, unlinked, and its retained descriptor is used by fixed /usr/bin/unzip -Z1/-p calls only; closed four-member inventory, byte bounds and captured ZIP hash are checked. Report bytes are never executed or used to select a destination. Credentials go only to the fixed GitHub API, not the signed transfer or logs. This is an intended authenticated inert-download write, not arbitrary remote file selection or execution. It does not certify hypothetical parser defects, hostile same-UID runner processes or broader archive-processing safety.
